verdict.rationale: cubic's own CLI lets you connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription to run its models, but the docs scope this to local reviews only. There is no evidence it powers cubic's coding/fix agent or that it is a full sign-in flow. missing for 10: subscription sign-in for the coding/fix agent beyond local CLI reviews, documented auth flow details, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Connect your existing **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** or **Claude Code** subscription to use its models for local reviews.
The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push.
